content.value_statement: Review comments can be scattered across GitHub threads and easy to miss. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through inspection, planning, fixes, and responses.
actual_capabilities: Checks GitHub CLI authentication before reviewing comments.
Retrieves pull request comments for the current branch.
Organizes comments and review threads into an action plan.
Requests user confirmation when many comments need work.
Guides code changes for selected review feedback.
Posts a GitHub PR comment after fixes are complete.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated GitHub CLI.
Depends on the current branch having an open pull request.
Does not directly resolve GitHub review threads.
Does not verify tests unless the user requests it.

use_cases.title: Triage Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Collect pull request comments and group them into clear repair tasks.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Large Review Updates
use_cases.description: Plan many requested changes before editing files or posting responses.

use_cases.title: Respond After Fixes
use_cases.description: Prepare concise GitHub responses once selected review comments are addressed.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect My PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use address-github-comments to inspect comments on my current branch and summarize what needs attention.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Comment Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the PR comments, group related feedback, and propose a fix plan before changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Address Selected Threads
prompt_templates.prompt: Address the approved PR comments only, update the relevant files, and explain each completed change.

prompt_templates.title: Finish Review Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect comments, categorize risks, implement approved fixes, verify results, and draft a final PR response.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for review feedback on the current branch.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a grouped task list, explains likely fixes, and asks which comments to address first.

output_examples.input: Several reviewer comments request related changes.
output_examples.output: The skill combines related feedback into one plan and separates questions from concrete code changes.
The skill prepares a concise PR response that says the feedback was addressed in the latest commit.

best_practices: Confirm GitHub CLI authentication before reading or posting comments.
Read surrounding code before changing files for a review comment.
Ask before posting responses or handling many requested changes.
anti_patterns: Do not post generic replies without fixing the underlying issue.
Do not treat every comment as correct without checking context.
Do not run custom scripts unless their purpose is clear.

faq.question: Does this skill require GitHub CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow depends on an installed and authenticated GitHub CLI.

faq.question: Can it modify code?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides code edits through the assistant after comments are reviewed.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it handle issue comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The description includes issue feedback, but the workflow focuses on pull requests.

faq.question: Does it automatically merge pull requests?
faq.answer: No. It addresses comments and can draft a response after fixes.

faq.question: Should comments be reviewed first?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow starts by inspecting comments before planning or applying changes.
